extracted.intended_audience: educated readers interested in natural theology and natural history; skeptics and those debating theism
extracted.subtask_description: Criteria and observational standards used by a natural-philosophy/ natural-theology writer to infer wisdom, purpose, or divine design from biological structures, life-cycles, and plant/animal anatomy. Focuses on concrete anatomical/physiological features and experimental observations invoked as evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Water as second cause producing fishes out of spawn
rubrics_metrics.description: This has respect to Water, which as a second Cause, produces these Fishes out of their Spawn.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as an explanatory criterion: if a medium (water) consistently produces a particular class of creatures (fish) from spawn, this regular, medium-specific production supports the interpretation of scriptural expressions (e.g., 'bringing forth abundantly' applied to fishes) and indicates knowledge of distinct causal relations in nature. Examples/notes: comparison to birds (produced in air) and to passages in Genesis (viii.17, ix.7).

rubrics_metrics.name: Extraordinary fecundity of fishes as evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: The Procreation of Birds ... is not ascribed to the Air ... whereas the expression of bringing forth abundantly is only found in relation to Fishes ... the abundance is obvious from the prodigious quantity of Eggs in their Spawn.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Large numbers, prolific spawning and many eggs (cited Psalm civ: 'innumerable') are treated as evidence of an intentional design feature (fecundity) that distinguishes fishes from other creatures. Used to argue that scriptural wording reflects informed knowledge of natural differences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Muscular arrangement in legless creeping creatures explains motion
rubrics_metrics.description: In great Worms ... the Muscles can be discovered some of which encompass the Worms like so many Rings, others are extended lengthwise ... when the long Muscles are contracted the Worm becomes shorter, and when the round ones, it is stretched out in length.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Empirical anatomical structure (ring and longitudinal muscles) used as a criterion to explain serpentine motion without legs. References for verification: Borelli (Motion of Animals), Mr. de la Hire (Mechanicks). The presence of appropriately arranged muscles is taken as evidence of purposeful design rather than chance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Metamorphosis and complete lifecycle as evidence of contrivance
rubrics_metrics.description: A Silk-worm comes out of an Egg furnished with all the Instruments for Moving, Eating and Digesting its Food ... Spinning itself up with the Silk that comes out of its own Bowels, it is turned into an Aurelia, from whence at last proceeds a Butterfly ... which lays eggs again.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The ordered sequence (egg → larva → cocoon/aurelia → butterfly → eggs) and the provision, from the egg state, of the instruments needed for each stage are cited as evidence of foresight/wisdom. Observational point: children breed silkworms and know the sequence; the timing of hatching synchronised with plant availability is emphasized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision of complete small-scale instruments in insects
rubrics_metrics.description: The Silk-worm ... is furnished with all the Instruments for Moving, Eating and Digesting its Food ... Spinning itself up with the Silk that comes out of its own Bowels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criterion: the presence in minute organisms of fully-formed organs and apparatus (for motion, nutrition, secretion) at hatching implies intentional arrangement. Used to argue that such complexity cannot plausibly arise from mere chance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Synchronization of insect development with food-plant emergence
rubrics_metrics.description: the little Eggs of those that we know are found by Experience not sooner to disclose their Young ones, than till the Herbs and Leaves that are to serve them for Nourishment, do spring out of the Ground or Trees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Temporal coordination between organismal life-cycles and environmental resources (e.g., eggs hatching when food-plants appear) is treated as evidence of design. Used to counter arguments that such timing is accidental.

rubrics_metrics.name: Microscopic discovery of numerous small instruments as demonstration of wisdom
rubrics_metrics.description: He that doubts herein, let him consult those great Enquirers, who by the help of their Microscopes have discovered as it were a new World, and thousands of otherwise invisible Creatures; in the inconceivable smallness of which ... the manifest Designs of the Creator ... shine forth as clear as the Sun.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criterion: features revealed only under magnification (tiny organs, structures) that exhibit complexity and apparent purpose count strongly towards an inference of design. Recommendation: consult firsthand microscopic observations (Leuwenhoek, Goedart, others).

rubrics_metrics.name: Structure of beetle/ fly eyes (many hexagonal facets) implies designed optics
rubrics_metrics.description: Each of the little Planes or Superficies of the Eye do appear ... to be an exact Hexangular Figure ... having counted those that are in the middle Line of the Eye, ... the number contained ... amounts at least to 8000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific optical design features — numerous small facets (hexagonal), convex/ globular surfaces — are shown to conform to laws of vision (convex surfaces produce inverted images), provide near-omnidirectional sight, and thus indicate contrivance. Empirical demonstrations cited: microscopic observation, candle-image experiment, comparison to ground glass/magnifying tubes, Leuwenhoek's counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conformity of insect-eye micro-geometry to optical laws (convexity, inversion)
rubrics_metrics.description: A convex or a more protuberant Figure is only required ... in order to show the exact Image of a luminous Object inverted ... a mathematician ... knows that this cannot be done by a concave or flat Figure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criterion: if microstructures obey known physical laws (refraction, formation of inverted images) and their shapes (convex/globular facets) fit those laws, this match between structure and physical function is evidence of purposeful design rather than random form. Experimental note: viewing candle images inverted through facets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concurrence of many necessary small properties in insect eyes indicates design
rubrics_metrics.description: If these little Particles or Eyes were not transparent, there would be no Sight; if each of them were not round, there would be a sight but confused; if they were not disposed in convex Superficies ... if the Membranes were not supplied with Humours proper for them ... the Sight would be ruined.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The simultaneous presence, in a very small space, of multiple necessary and complementary properties (transparency, roundness, convexity, arrangement, humours, vessels) is used as a cumulative criterion: the conjunction of many interdependent features increases improbability of chance and supports inference to design. Suggested empirical check: microscopic and light experiments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seed contains a miniature of the future plant (Planta Seminalis)
rubrics_metrics.description: Having enquired into a vast Number [of seeds], they have discovered and seen in every single Seed an Involved Stamen of the future Plant, which by ... is named Planta Seminalis, or the Seed-plant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criterion: microscopic/anatomical observation that seeds include organized, rolled-up structures corresponding to the future plant (stem, leaves, nodes) counts as evidence of foresight/arrangement. Authorities cited: Grew, Malpighi, Leuwenhoek.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seed anatomy: cotyledons, root-sprout, pluma (feather) and seed-root feeding the sprout
rubrics_metrics.description: Take some great dry Beans ... strip the Skin off ... you will find the Body of the Bean consist of two Parts ... and having a little white Stalk or Sprig ... the white Root-Sprig ... which afterwards in the Earth becomes the Root of the Plant ... the Seed-root ... carried on to the white little Point c ... furnishes this little Root-Sprig ... with nutritious juices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical observational experiment: soak beans, remove skin, observe cotyledons, root-sprout, pluma and the internal seed-root network. Use finding as a criterion: internal arrangement that supplies nutrition and organizes early growth implies purposeful design. References: Tab. XVII Fig.4 and Grew.

rubrics_metrics.name: Most plants have two roots (seed-root then earth-root)
rubrics_metrics.description: Almost every Plant ... is thus furnished with two Roots; the first ... is call'd the Seed-root feeding the little Root-Sprout ... so long till the first of those is big enough to draw Nourishment ... then it becomes the second and last Root.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criterion: the presence of a functional succession (seed-root feeding early sprout, later replaced by earth-root) and the built-in provisioning for that transition (seed-root structure) demonstrate an organized developmental plan rather than accidental formation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protective cavity and hole in seed coat enabling safe handling and sprout emergence
rubrics_metrics.description: In each Part of the Bean, there was form'd a small Cavity to place the said Pluma, and to preserve it ... Beans may be handled, thrown together in Heaps, and tossed into Sacks, without the least prejudice to the said tender Trunk ... the external Coat ... is always pierced or bored through with a very little Hole, directly opposite to the Point of the Root-sprout ... in order that when the Seed is sown ... this Root-Sprout may not be hinder'd ... from growing out.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criterion: morphological features that protect delicate embryonic parts (cavities, sheathes) while also allowing controlled emergence (orifice) are evidence of adaptive, purposeful structure. Examples: large beans, nuts, hard peach-stones showing similar orifice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Directional change of nutritive sap during germination
rubrics_metrics.description: The Nutritious Juice ... proceeding first from the Matter of the Body of the Seed ... through the Seed-root ... causes the Root-sprout to fix itself below in the Ground; after which it changes its Course ... and then on the contrary, taking its way upwards, it causes the Pluma to shoot forth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criterion: regulated physiological changes (nutrient routing first to root-sprout, then redirected to pluma/trunk when root can draw from soil) indicate coordinated functional design. Observational/experimental implication: track sap flow during germination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seed-leaves (cotyledons) as necessary structures for early nourishment and protection
rubrics_metrics.description: These Seed-particles ... compose the Seed-leaves ... the Seed-leaves are absolutely necessary in preserving and nourishing of the Trunk, and for the increase of the Plant ... if they be pulled off ... it will hardly grow; and if it should any ways increase, it won't be compleat, but remain always defective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Experimental criterion: removal experiments (Malpighi) show seed-leaves are necessary for full, normal development. Use as evidence of adaptive design of seed architecture.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seed-plant is a rolled-up, miniature, proportionally different version of the adult plant
rubrics_metrics.description: In each Seed ... there is such a little Seed-Plant ... in which all the Parts of the Plant that are to proceed from it, are involved or rolled up as it were like a Clew of Thread; which being afterwards filled and expanded by Nutritious Juices becomes an entire and compleat Plant ... (Dodart's observation of an ear of corn scarcely a line high but containing nodes, tubes and little seeds).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criterion: morphological compactness — the organized, telescoped miniature of the adult (tubes inside tubes, nodes, miniature leaves and ear) demonstrates preformation/organized plan. Example: Dodart's micro-observations of a young ear of corn with miniature nodes and tubes. The proportional differences but structural homologies between embryo and adult are emphasized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reproducible species-specific development in identical medium indicates intrinsic organizing principle
rubrics_metrics.description: When we sow the Seed of a fine and sweet smelling Flower, one ... of nourishing Corn, and another of a poisonous Plant in the same sort of Earth, each of them will produce a Plant according to its own Nature, differing so much in Figure, in Strength, and other Properties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criterion: species-stability / faithful reproduction across identical external conditions argues for an internal, species-specific organizing cause rather than blind chance. Suggested reflection: difficulty of imagining such faithful differentiation arising without wisdom; appeals to experiment and experience.
